cases.name: Mary Ann Becker
cases.about: According to news reports at the time, Mary Ann was a "shy and quiet type of girl", an "A student at Atkinson High School."
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: On 9/9/1974, she was found strangled in her family's living room. She had been tied to a piano, and an electrical cord found near her body.
